limitations.note: The agent fixed the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed the exits from `s4_d0110` to reuse the terminal zero, whereas the correct fix leaves those transitions unchanged.
The test exercised overlapping sequences, but its rolling-history oracle expected the new overlap behavior, so it passed the extra transition change instead of detecting it as a regression.
